claims_extracted.claim: The BBN gateway implementation described in RFC 823 runs on DEC PDP-11 and LSI-11 16-bit processors.
claims_extracted.notes: Future pass should replace this section-level locator with exact paragraph/section numbering from the canonical text representation.

claims_extracted.claim: The described implementation separates device drivers, network-specific software, and shared gateway software.
The interface inventory includes 1822 hardware, Proteon Ring, RSRE HDLC, Interlan Ethernet and BBN Fibernet attachments, with additional interfaces planned.
claims_extracted.notes: Individual interface boards require separate vendor-manual confirmation.

claims_extracted.claim: Operational traps and monitoring were sent to an Internet Network Operations Center (INOC).
